request.style: English, male solo voice, deep and melancholic, acoustic guitar, bodhran, fiddle, uilleann pipes, slow waltz 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David fled the king of Israel
Crossed the border to Gath's gate
Achish sat upon his throne
But the servants knew his name
They sang of David's fame
Saul struck thousands, David ten
David's heart was filled with fear
He knew his days were done

[Chorus]
Madman make marks on the door
Spittle runs down your beard
Why bring such a fool to me
Look at him, he is mad

[Verse]
Six hundred men with him came
Two wives in his household
Ziklag was given that day
Saul stopped his search
David raided the south
Geshurites and Amalekites
He told the king it was Judah
Deception in his eyes

[Chorus]
Madman make marks on the door
Spittle runs down your beard
Why bring such a fool to me
Look at him, he is mad

[Bridge]
Bodyguard for life he said
March with me against Israel
But the rulers said no
Send the Hebrew back away
Trust was broken in the court
David left with heavy heart

[Outro]
Two slaves ran to Gath
Shimei broke his oath to Solomon
Achish son of Maacah
King of Gath, the end
